name: @shadcn-sandbox/ui
description: Barrel over the shadcn copy-in sources under ../src/components/ui — shadcn is NOT an installable component package (its CLI vendors source into the host app), so this local path dependency gives the capture harness a `library.package` to mount. The true pin is the vendored source files themselves (sha256 ledger in examples/shadcn/RECON.md); this version string is the barrel's, not shadcn's.
